label: signet ring
construction: A signet ring: one continuous shank widening into a solid flat face (oval or cushion). The mark sits on the face only, engraved or raised, centered, with a clear margin all round. No loose parts.
photo: Studio product photograph, soft even lighting, white seamless background, subtle shadow, the piece fills the frame, no text, no people, no props.
